items.item:
5. A sign-in during a lockout is refused and does not extend it.
   Shows A13-2. [witness: verification:registry_a13_lockout_sign_in_not_extending]
statements:
```text
owner_session s valid at t <=> t < s.began + 8h and   -- A13-1
                                t < s.last_request + 30min and
                                not signed_out(s) and no restart since s.began
refused_sign_ins(last 15min) >= 5 => sign_in refused   -- A13-2
```

verdicts.item:
5. A sign-in during a lockout is refused and does not extend it.
   Shows A13-2. [witness: verification:registry_a13_lockout_sign_in_not_extending]
statements:
```text
owner_session s valid at t <=> t < s.began + 8h and   -- A13-1
                                t < s.last_request + 30min and
                                not signed_out(s) and no restart since s.began
refused_sign_ins(last 15min) >= 5 => sign_in refused   -- A13-2
```
verdicts.why: The check establishes a lockout with five refused sign-ins, detects further right- and wrong-credential sign-ins as refused during it, then requires a successful sign-in exactly 15 minutes after the fifth original refusal. Acceptance at that original expiry demonstrates that the intervening sign-ins neither extended nor restarted the lockout.
